name: @ryntra/api-client
description: Typed client for the Ryntra API v1 native contract: capabilities, Sign In With Solana into a bearer session, the proven wallet's watchlist; since 1.1.0 the Trading Plan, its Review block, its execution binding and the device registry as types; since 1.5.0 the evidence observation a plan's conditions are judged on, with the registry of what a condition may name; since 1.8.0 Ryntra, the AI assistant — the proven wallet's conversation, its structured answers, cards, drafts and budget; since 1.9.0 Results beyond the entry — an operation as an entry or an exit, the cost parts kept apart, an exit judged only by rules that existed before it, the plans that made no trade, the positions, and a strategy memory whose every fact cites its record. Since 1.11.0 the routes the clients already consume outside /api/v1 — the markets, the stocks, the holdings, the activity, the receipt archive, the rewards, the monitoring, the predictions and the swap — typed as they are served, with read methods that throw RyntraRouteError, and the Telegram channel over the bearer. Since 1.20.0 «Перевірка» — the four lines and the reserve the server counts for a purchase or a sale of a company, on the swap's quote and order — and «Популярне», the companies by the day's trading. Since 1.21.0 Нагляд over the wallet's company positions — each with its exit, its state and its one action, decided by the server — and «Ryntra попередить» turned on with a preset. Since 1.22.0 «Гроші» — payment links made, listed and read, a Ryntra link paid through its own routes, the recipient check before a transfer, Send on the transfer routes with «Перевірка» counted by the server and the reading of what the wallet returned. Since 1.23.0 «Ризик портфеля» — one word for the wallet as a whole, with every rule broken or what could not be read, decided by the server. Since 1.24.0 fee policy v2 — a swap's Ryntra fee by its flow, and the /build lane whose fee is paid whole into Ryntra's fee wallet. Since 1.25.0 Ryntra Launch — the presets, the token's metadata, the first purchase under its cap, the creation and the creator's lock to sign, the submit and the token's read with its launch receipt — served where capabilities.launch is present. Since 1.26.0 the Rewards rank — the rank by points over 30 days, the share a friend's trade pays at it, and the ladder. Since 1.27.0 a launch's market — the price and market cap, the curve's way to the DEX, the holders with their labels, the trades, the chart, the facts of risk and the creator's other launches — and buying and selling it on its curve or in its pool. Since 1.28.0 the Rewards badges — every rank the wallet has reached and when, and its achievements. Since 1.29.0 the creator's cabinet — a wallet's launches, what each earned it by source, «Забрати» with its receipt, the creator earnings card — and «Спільнота» sharing the creator's fees. No runtime dependency beyond fetch.
